description: Xena Studios' shared Renovate settings. A repo uses them with "extends": ["local>xena-studios/.github:renovate-config"] and adds its own rules, such as automerge where CI covers everything a merge changes.

packageRules.description: Third-party actions run with the repo's secrets, so they're pinned to a commit (CodeQL flags tags, which can be moved); Renovate keeps the pins current. GitHub's own actions stay on tags. Every repo gets this; a repo's own copy of the rule is harmless.
